note: Candidate keys per action, tried in order by calibration (auto_record.ps1 -Calibrate). Webbed's default bindings were NOT recovered from the binary; these are guesses that calibration confirms against the game's own input object (oIO). The confirmed result is saved to DesktopPlaygroundLocal\auto_bindings.local.json, outside the repository.
retract_probe_note: Tried one at a time by W4_retract_probe WHILE a grapple is attached and held; for each key the probe records which oIO / player variables change and whether the rope distance trend changes. Keys already bound to grapple, jump or walking are skipped.
